# Homework Task

- Read in global gender inequality data.
- Join the global gender inequality index to spatial data of the World, creating a new column of **difference in inequality between 2010 and 2019**.

## Plan

- Read data

  - HDR25_Composite_indices_complete_time_series.csv

  - World_Countries_(Generalized)_8414823838130214587.gpkg

- Select columns
- Join

## Read data

- Read csv file
- Read world shape

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)

hdi <- read_csv("week4_data/HDR25_Composite_indices_complete_time_series.csv",
                    locale = locale(encoding = "latin1"),
                       na = " ", skip=0)


hdi

worldShape <- st_read("week4_data/World_Countries_(Generalized)_8414823838130214587.gpkg")
```

## Select columns
- Select `iso3`, `country`, gii_2010` and `gii_2019` columns

```{r}
library(janitor)
library(dplyr)
library(countrycode)

giiDiff <- hdi %>%
  clean_names()%>%
  select(iso3, country, gii_2019, gii_2010)%>%
  mutate(difference=gii_2019-gii_2010)%>%
  mutate(iso_code=countrycode(country, origin = 'country.name', destination = 'iso2c'))%>%
  mutate(iso_code2=countrycode(iso3, origin ='iso3c', destination = 'iso2c'))

```

## Join

```{r}
joinData <- worldShape %>% 
  clean_names() %>%
  left_join(., 
            giiDiff,
            # change to "aff_iso" = "iso_code"
            by = c("iso" = "iso_code"))
```
